title: Structure Pack Trio #20 (임산부 큰 조각 4개·물결 / 일반 폴카도트·물결 / 일반 셰브론·물결 | 이레즈미+금박+인어비늘+공작눈무늬 / 금박+석재+뱀비늘+흑요암금 / 코이비늘+석재+인어비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Latina, in her late 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real pores, real living eyes, 5 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a bracelet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper right edge of her figure to the lower left edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 29% of the way along its length and runs to the upper left edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 75% of the way along its length and runs to the lower right edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper right): it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, raijin thunder drums formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and STARK GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper left): it carries applied ROSE-GOLD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower right): it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower left): it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Chinese, in her late 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real pores, real living eyes, 8 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with sapphires in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal an anklet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 3 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 22% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 42% of the way down her figure from the top and about 58% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries solid polished jade-green stone fused directly into her own form, natural cloudy veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface with VIVID pale-green vein striations. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 20% of the way down her figure from the top and about 23% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the round patch centred about 55% of the way down her figure from the top and about 28% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. The patch edges are hazy and feathered — there is no visible outline at all. Around each patch, a transition zone about a hand's width wide lets the patch's material and the background material dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Filipina, in her early 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver a hair ornament. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 chevron-shaped bands by 2 hazy transition zones, each shaped like a V pointing down with rounded sides: each zone runs from one side edge of her figure sloping downward to the centre line, where it forms the tip of the V, then continues sloping upward to the opposite side edge. The tips of the V shapes sit about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first V-shaped transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the chevron band between V-shaped zone 1 and V-shaped zone 2: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. Region 3 is everything below the last V-shaped transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
